sources.quote: Every second of delay costs conversions
sources.title: Find Out How You Stack Up to New Industry Benchmarks for Mobile Page Speed
sources.evidence: 53% of mobile site visits are abandoned if a page takes longer than 3 seconds to load. As page load time goes from one second to seven seconds, the probability of a mobile site visitor bouncing increases 113%. In retail, a one second delay in mobile can impact mobile conversions by up to 20%.

sources.quote: call tracking so those calls are counted as conversions
sources.title: About phone call conversion tracking - Google Ads Help
sources.evidence: Conversion tracking helps you find how ad clicks lead to different kinds of phone calls: calls from ads, calls to a phone number on your website (via a Google forwarding number), click-based tracking and imported call conversions. You set a minimum call length, and every call that lasts at least that long is counted as a conversion.

flags.quote: or association badges. Prospects are looking for a reason to believe
flags.issue: The list of trust signals immediately before this span names the Google Guaranteed badge. Google discontinued the Google Guarantee badge and its money-back guarantee effective October 20, 2025, replacing Google Guaranteed, Google Screened and License Verified by Google with a single Google Verified badge for Local Services Ads advertisers.
